verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional documents a rejection denylist with an allowlist override (docs-17). Its webhooks emit hard-bounce, spam, unsub and reject events (docs-18), which implies suppressed addresses are rejected. A community report describes Mailchimp itself removing list members over spam complaints (comm-11), but nothing documents automatic suppression shared across Marketing and Transactional sends, and comm-6 notes the two services remain unintegrated. Missing for 10: explicit docs on automatic bounce/unsubscribe/complaint suppression in Marketing campaigns, a suppression list shared across all send types (marketing, transactional, SMS), CAN-SPAM/GDPR default-compliance documentation, and hands-on corroboration.
